strategy: Play Dimir control: use cheap interaction and tutors to set up [[Mindcrank]] with either [[Duskmantle Guildmage]] or [[Bloodchief Ascension]], so you can win without resolving your six-mana commander. [[Windfall]] stocks opposing graveyards for [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]], while [[Lightning Greaves]] lets him attack before opponents untap. Free countermagic, fast mana, and compact combos put the deck firmly in Optimized Bracket 4, with a game plan that expects at least four turns rather than racing for a pre-turn-four win.

research.summary:
**[[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] is best built as a theft-control commander with a mill package.** Mill is EDHREC’s largest tagged archetype, but you don’t have to empty a library to get value: you just need a good instant or sorcery in the graveyard of the opponent you hit. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/wrexial-the-risen-deep))

1. **Main builds.** **Mill** either stocks opposing graveyards or commits to decking the table. **Theft/control** uses discard, removal, and selective milling to set up profitable attacks. **Reanimator** makes use of the creatures you mill, while **sea-creature builds** lean into big threats and combat. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/wrexial-the-risen-deep))
2. **Key engines.** [[Windfall]] refills your hand and stocks graveyards; [[Drown in the Loch]] turns those stocked yards into cheap interaction. [[Tasha, the Witch Queen]] gives you another way to cast opposing spells, and [[Sepulchral Primordial]] turns milled creatures into your board. [[Lightning Greaves]] gives your six-mana commander a chance to connect before opponents untap. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/wrexial-the-risen-deep))
3. **Common combo finishes.**
   - **[[Duskmantle Guildmage]] + [[Mindcrank]]:** Activate the Guildmage’s first ability, then make an opponent lose life or put a card into their graveyard. Mill and life loss feed each other, usually killing that opponent; each opponent needs a spark. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/combos/wrexial-the-risen-deep))
   - **[[Bruvac the Grandiloquent]] + kicked [[Maddening Cacophony]]:** Mills every opponent’s entire library, barring replacement effects. They lose when they next try to draw, not when the spell resolves. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/combos/wrexial-the-risen-deep))
4. **What I’d cut first.** In theft/control, skip small one-shot mill like [[Mind Sculpt]]: it costs a card without affecting the board or guaranteeing a useful spell. Avoid blanket graveyard hate like [[Rest in Peace]], which shuts off your own engine. And don’t overload on expensive sea creatures unless that’s the plan—the commander already competes for your six-mana turn. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/wrexial-the-risen-deep/theft?utm_source=openai))
5. **Mana base.** Start around **37 lands** with cheap ramp such as [[Arcane Signet]], [[Talisman of Dominance]], and [[Dimir Signet]]. Prioritize untapped colored sources like [[Underground River]] and [[Watery Grave]]: you need two blue and one black to cast the commander, plus enough early blue for interaction. [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] is especially valuable because it gives opponents’ lands the Swamp type, turning on swampwalk against anyone who controls a land. Keep colorless utility lands and slow taplands to a minimum. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/wrexial-the-risen-deep))

Activate Academy Ruins's ability targeting Mindslaver in graveyard.
Pass to opponent's turn.
Pass to your turn and draw Mindslaver.
Play Mindslaver, use it, and target it with Academy Ruins.

produces: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
combosOneAway.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.

Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Each Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

cards: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
missing: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

combosOneAway.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Rite of Replication, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Rite of Replication, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

produces: Return all nonland permanents to owner's hand each turn
combosOneAway.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Kederekt Leviathan triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.

synergies.title: Swampwalk and a Mana Surge
synergies.explanation: [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] makes every land a Swamp, so [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] can attack any opponent who controls a land without being blocked. It also makes every land you control count toward [[Cabal Coffers]], helping pay for your commander and its commander tax.

synergies.title: Two Spell Thieves
synergies.explanation: [[Sakashima the Impostor]] can copy [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] while keeping a different name, so both survive the legend rule. Send them at different opponents to tap two graveyards, or send both at one opponent with multiple spells worth stealing.

synergies.title: Haste With Backup
synergies.explanation: [[Lightning Greaves]] lets [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] attack the turn it comes down and gives it shroud once equipped. With your commander on the battlefield, [[Fierce Guardianship]] can counter a noncreature answer for free, even while the equip ability is still on the stack.

synergies.title: Discard Their Hands, Draw Their Cards
synergies.explanation: Cast [[Windfall]] before combat to stock opposing graveyards with spells for [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]]. [[Notion Thief]] redirects the opponents' replacement hands to you, leaving them empty-handed instead of letting them reload.

synergies.title: Draw, Mill, and Deny
synergies.explanation: [[Consecrated Sphinx]] can keep your hand full, so your own [[Dreamborn Muse]] trigger may mill you heavily; the upside is that opponents with full hands also mill heavily on their upkeeps. Those opposing graveyards give [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] more spells to steal and let [[Drown in the Loch]] answer more expensive threats.

synergies.title: Double Dynamo
synergies.explanation: Have [[Sculpting Steel]] copy [[Thran Dynamo]], then use [[Tezzeret the Seeker]] to untap both after tapping them. That produces twelve colorless mana in one main phase, enough to cover a large commander tax or most of an expensive spell.

synergies.title: Land Tutor on Repeat
synergies.explanation: Sacrifice [[Expedition Map]] to find whichever half of [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] and [[Cabal Coffers]] you are missing, then use [[Academy Ruins]] to put the spent artifact back on top of your library. That lets one tutor assemble both lands over successive draws.

original.summary: Get [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] through unblocked and cast the best spells from opponents’ graveyards. Close with commander damage, stolen threats, or a big [[Exsanguinate]].
early: Play [[Dimir Signet]] early so your colorless mana can help cast [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]].
Use [[Expedition Map]] to find whichever half of your big mana pair is missing.
Find [[Expedition Map]] or [[Mana Vault]] with [[Trinket Mage]], depending on what you need.
mid: Pair [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] with [[Cabal Coffers]] for mana and unblockable commander attacks.
Attack with [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] where you can connect and steal the best spell.
Copy [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] with [[Sakashima the Impostor]] to steal spells with both.
late: Copy [[Thran Dynamo]] with [[Sculpting Steel]], then untap both with [[Tezzeret the Seeker]].
Recycle [[Expedition Map]] with [[Academy Ruins]] to find another key land.
Overload [[Cyclonic Rift]] before attacking with the threats you stole through [[Blatant Thievery]].
winConditions: Land five hits with [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] to eliminate a player through commander damage.
Pour mana from [[Cabal Coffers]] into [[Exsanguinate]] to drain the whole table.
Use [[Bribery]] to steal the creature most likely to win through combat.

keyCards.name: Wrexial, the Risen Deep
keyCards.why: Turns unblocked hits into free spells from opposing graveyards.

keyCards.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
keyCards.why: Turns opposing lands into swamps so your commander slips through.

keyCards.name: Cabal Coffers
keyCards.why: Produces the big mana your finishers need.

keyCards.name: Lightning Greaves
keyCards.why: Lets your commander attack immediately and dodge targeted removal.

keyCards.name: Exsanguinate
keyCards.why: Converts excess mana into life loss for every opponent.

original.mulligan: Keep two or three lands with blue access and early acceleration like [[Dimir Signet]] or [[Sol Ring]].
watchOut: Graveyard exile can remove the spell [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] targets before you cast it.
[[Lightning Greaves]] also stops your own [[Rite of Replication]] from targeting the equipped creature.
Without [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]], [[Cabal Coffers]] may produce too little mana to help.

optimized.summary: [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] turns discarded and milled spells into free casts. Finish with a [[Mindcrank]] loop or pour mana from [[Cabal Coffers]] into [[Exsanguinate]].
early: Use [[Sol Ring]] to deploy [[Dimir Signet]] and get both commander colors online.
Use [[Expedition Map]] to find whichever half of [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] and [[Cabal Coffers]] you're missing.
Land [[Rhystic Study]] early so opposing spells can refill your hand while you ramp.
mid: Equip [[Lightning Greaves]] to [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] for an immediate swing.
Attack whoever has the best spell in their graveyard that [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] can reach.
Flash in [[Notion Thief]] before [[Windfall]] to refill your hand and stock opposing graveyards.
late: Use [[Tezzeret the Seeker]] to fetch [[Mindcrank]] or untap [[Thran Dynamo]] before casting [[Exsanguinate]].
Copy [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]] with [[Sakashima the Impostor]] to steal two spells per combat.
winConditions: With [[Mindcrank]] out, activate [[Duskmantle Guildmage]]’s life-loss ability, then make an opponent mill or lose life.
Pair [[Mindcrank]] with a fully charged [[Bloodchief Ascension]], then make each opponent mill or lose life.
Fuel a lethal [[Exsanguinate]] with [[Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]] and [[Cabal Coffers]].

keyCards.name: Wrexial, the Risen Deep
keyCards.why: Turns combat damage into free spells from the defending player's graveyard.

keyCards.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
keyCards.why: Enables swampwalk and makes every land count for [[Cabal Coffers]].

keyCards.name: Mindcrank
keyCards.why: Turns life loss into milling for both graveyard loops.

keyCards.name: Windfall
keyCards.why: Stocks opposing graveyards and refills your hand with [[Notion Thief]].

optimized.mulligan: Keep lands covering both colors, early ramp like [[Dimir Signet]], and draw or cheap interaction.
watchOut: Graveyard exile can remove the spell you target with [[Wrexial, the Risen Deep]].
[[Lightning Greaves]] prevents your own [[Sakashima the Impostor]] from targeting nothing because copying doesn't target.
